signals.name: service-health
signals.queryText: AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(15m) | where CategoryValue == "ServiceHealth" | summarize Value = countif(Level in ("Error", "Critical"))

signals.displayName: Failed ARM operations in this resource group
signals.name: failed-arm-operations
signals.queryText: AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(15m) | where CategoryValue == "Administrative" | where ResourceGroup =~ "group-66bdbf2ad096" | summarize Value = countif(ActivityStatusValue in ("Failed", "Failure"))

signals.name: platform-alerts
signals.queryText: AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(15m) | where CategoryValue == "Alert" | summarize Value = count()
